message: Donation heat check: **JaxikoLane (86)** is still printing value for the clan, with **King Thing (74)** and **King Levy (70)** right behind—builders doing builder work. Trophy tower looks nasty up top: **raquaza (12,341)** and **Vijay (12,070)** are keeping *Magic Academy* locked, and **Chanco** is cruising *Royal Road* with that **Inferno Dragon + Skeleton King** “you shall not pass” kit. War wake-up call: River Race is live and we’ve only got battles from **shimmeringhost** and **King Levy** so far—if you’re able today, burn your **4 decks** and put points on the board. Card flavor of the day: **Vijay’s Bats + Zap** cycle and **Levy’s Witch + Skeleton Barrel** nonsense are exactly the kind of chaos we weaponize.
